events.body:
## Outcome

Let people read without an account and submit signed issues, comments, reviews, and pull requests from a browser identity that can later move to a full node.

## Implementation

- Generate an Ed25519 contribution identity in the browser and keep the encrypted private material in local protected storage.
- Add passkey, standards-based identity-provider, and email magic-link session adapters without making any one adapter mandatory.
- Queue signed contributions offline and submit them through the existing bounded inbox when connectivity returns.
- Provide an explicit export and handoff flow into the recoverable identity model in #447.
- Keep anonymous access read-only and apply existing rate, size, signature, and attachment validation before inbox storage.

## Acceptance criteria

- A clean browser can submit each supported contribution without installing a node.
- Private signing material never reaches logs, analytics, URLs, or server storage.
- Offline replay is idempotent and preserves the original signed bytes.
- Identity handoff retains authorship and revokes the abandoned browser device when requested.
- Anonymous mutation attempts and invalid sessions fail without creating inbox state.

## Dependencies

Uses the existing signed contribution inbox; coordinates identity upgrade with #447.

## Verification

Exercise anonymous reads, each sign-in adapter, browser-key creation, offline queue/replay, duplicate submission, handoff, revocation, rate limits, and secret-leak scans in browser tests.
